validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" initial="p">
  <state id="p" initial="c">
    <history id="h"/>
    <state id="c">
      <transition event="go" target="d"/>
    </state>
    <final id="d"/>
  </state>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: history must contain exactly one transition
notes: the history transition defines the default configuration used before the parent state was ever exited
diagnostics.help: add exactly one target-only transition inside `history`
